title: agoseris laciniata
intro: Agoseris laciniata, commonly known as the cut-leaf agoseris or laciniated agoseris, is a perennial plant species in the sunflower family (Asteraceae). This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include its use in traditional medicine to treat various ailments such as fever, sore throats, and skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of Agoseris laciniata are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antiviral, and antioxidant properties, which may help to soothe and calm irritated tissues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, sesquiterpenes, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
